June 2, 1936. Morning translation.
Society Evening News (社会晚报) dated June 1:-
IRON FOUNDRY WORKERS ON STRIKE
With the object of bringing about a
reduction in their working hours, the workers of one hundred
local iron foundries went on strike on May 27. Later,
instructions were issued by the local Tangpu and other
Government organs that the present number of working hours
will be maintained. The workers are demanding that their
wages be not reduced for the period of the strike.
The managements of the various foundries
have not issued the wages for last month. With a view to
bringing about a settlement of the dispute, the Iron
Foundry Owners Association will call a meeting of members
at 2 p.m. to-day at its office at No.16 Siking Road.

铁厂工人罢工
为缩短工时，本地一百家铁厂的工人于5月27日举行罢工。随后，当地党部及其他政府机关发出指示，维持现有工时不变。工人们要求罢工期间工资不减。

4 May 29, 1936.

Nantao Tramway Company - transient strike of employees

700 mechanics, conductors and drivers of the Nantao
Tramway Company declared a strike at 11.30 a.m. May 28
to enforce a demand for permission to hold a general
meeting of all workers of the company. The permission
to hold this meeting was refused by the local Tangpu. The
service was, however, restored two hours later when the
employees resumed unconditionally with the exception of
thirty mechanics who are still on strike. The service is
normal this morning, May 29.

Iron Foundry Workers - labour situation

About 200 out of the 2,000 iron foundry workers in
Shanghai continue on strike this morning, although all
the foundries are operating.

Forty-two iron foundry owners held a meeting in the
Preparatory Office of the Iron Foundry Owners' Association,
16 Siking Road, between 4.30 p.m. and 7 p.m. May 28. Van
Kuo-an (范公安 ), owner of the Fuh Shing Iron Foundry,
Lane 390, 163 Chemulpo Road, who presided, reported that
the workers had submitted the following demands :-

1) That the Foundry Owners' Association obtain the release
of Nyien Loh-nyi (倪祿年), who was arrested by the
Municipal Police on May 26 on charges of assault and
malicious damage and was sentenced by the Court on
the following day to 50 days' detention.

2) That the foundry owners bear the expenses for the
maintenance of Nyien's family while he is in custody.

3) That pay for the period of the strike be issued to the
workers.

After a discussion, the following resolutions were
passed:-
1. That the workers' demands be rejected.
2. That should the workers declare a strike, a lockout in
all foundries be enforced.

南市电车公司——雇员短暂罢工

南市电车公司的700名机修工、售票员和司机于5月28日上午11时30分宣布罢工，以强制要求允许召开公司全体工人大会。当地党部拒绝了召开此次会议的许可。然而，两小时后服务恢复，除三十名仍在罢工的机修工外，其他员工无条件复工。今晨（5月29日）服务正常。

铁厂工人——劳资状况

尽管所有铁厂均在运营，但上海2,000名铁厂工人中，今晨仍有约200人继续罢工。

四十二位铁厂业主于5月28日下午4时30分至7时，在西康路16号铁厂业主公会筹备处举行会议。主持会议的是富兴铁厂老板范公安（Van Kuo-an），其厂址位于化学路163弄390号。他报告称，工人提出了以下要求：

1) 要求铁厂业主公会设法释放倪祿年（Nyien Loh-nyi）。倪于5月26日因袭击和恶意破坏罪被工部局警务处逮捕，并于次日被法院判处拘留50天。

2) 要求铁厂业主承担倪在被拘押期间其家属的生活费用。

3) 要求向工人发放罢工期间的工资。

经讨论，通过以下决议：
1. 拒绝工人的要求。
2. 若工人宣布罢工，则对所有铁厂实行闭厂。

May 28, 1936.

Labour

Mei Wen Silk Weaving Factory - reduces working period
The Mei Wen Silk Weaving Factory, Lane 645, No.15
Chang Ping Road, reduced the daily working period by
three and a half hours on May 27. The company employs
300 workers.

Jen Ho Cigar Factory - resumes operations
The Jen Ho Cigar Factory, 55 Penang Road, which
suspended operations on May 14 (Vide I.R.16/5/36), resumed
on May 27. The company employs a total complement of
80 workers.

Chong Ming Electric Appliance Factory - removed
The Chong Ming ( 昌 明 ) Electric Appliance
Factory, which has in its employ 120 workers, has removed
from Lane 611, No.10 Chengtu Road to 170 Mapai Road.

Iron Foundry Workers - majority resume work
The majority of iron foundry workers, who ceased work
on May 26 (Vide I.R.27/5/36) resumed this morning, pending
a settlement of the dispute by the local Kuomintang and
the Iron Foundry Workers' Union.
On the morning of May 27, four representatives of the
Iron Foundry Workers' Union called at the Bureau of Social
Affairs and the local Kuomintang and submitted the following
demands :-
1) That the daily working period be fixed at 9 hours.
2) That Nyien Loh-nyi ( 倪祿年 ), arrested by the S.M.P. on
charges of assault and malicious damage, be released
immediately.
3) That pay for the period of the strike be granted to the
workers.

劳工

美纹丝织厂——缩短工时
位于昌平路15号645弄的美纹丝织厂于5月27日将每日工时减少了三个半小时。该公司雇用300名工人。

仁和雪茄厂——恢复运营
位于槟榔路55号的仁和雪茄厂于5月14日暂停运营（参见1936年5月16日情报报告），于5月27日恢复运营。该公司共雇用80名工人。

昌明电器厂——搬迁
雇用120名工人的昌明（Chong Ming）电器厂已从成都路10号611弄迁至马派路170号。

铁厂工人——多数复工
多数于5月26日停工的铁厂工人（参见1936年5月27日情报报告）于今晨复工，等待当地国民党党部和铁厂工会解决纠纷。
5月27日上午，铁厂工会的四名代表拜访了社会局和当地国民党党部，并提交了以下要求：
1) 将每日工时固定为9小时。
2) 立即释放因袭击和恶意破坏罪被工部局警务处逮捕的倪祿年（Nyien Loh-nyi）。
3) 向工人发放罢工期间的工资。

May 28, 1936.

- 3 -

At 3 p.m. the same day, four members of the Iron
Foundry Workers' Union at a meeting held in their office,
20 Loh Ka Zah, South Station Road, Nantao, decided to
comply with an instruction of the local Kuomintang and
resume work pending a settlement of the dispute.

This morning, the Union issued copies of a notice
to workers in various iron foundries. A full translation
of the notice is as follows :-

Notification of the Shanghai Municipality Iron
Foundry Workers' Union

Notice is hereby given that in connection with the
strike of workers following the arrest by the S.M.P. of
Nyien Loh-nyi, a worker of the Zung Kee Iron Foundry,
at the instance of the management, the local Kuomintang
has detailed a representative named Li Vee-hsiung
(李維熊) to mediate in the dispute, and he has instructed
that the workers should resume pending a settlement. It
is to be noted that this Union is under the directorship
of the Chinese Kuomintang and therefore is bound to obey
its instructions and wait patiently for a settlement.
The workers in the iron foundry trade are hereby notified
to obey the Tangpu instruction and resume work from date.

(chopped by the Union).

Sequel to the ejection of a tenant from the
Dong Shing Cotton Mill quarters on May 19

The case against the male Chinese who was charged
with assaulting a Japanese subject during the ejection of
a tenant from the Dong Shing Cotton Mill quarters, Macao
Road, on May 19 (Vide I.R. 20/5/36) was withdrawn by the
complainant at the Shanghai Special District Court on
May 27.

当日下午3时，铁厂工会的四名成员在其位于南市车站南路陆家嘴20号的办事处举行的会议上，决定服从当地国民党党部的指示，在纠纷解决前先复工。

今晨，工会向各铁厂的工人分发了通知副本。通知全文翻译如下：

上海市铁厂工会通告

兹通告，鉴于众记铁厂工人倪祿年被资方提请工部局警务处逮捕后引发的工人罢工一事，当地国民党党部已指派名为李維熊（Li Vee-hsiung）的代表进行调解，并指示工人在解决纠纷前先复工。需注意，本工会受中国国民党指导，因此必须服从其指示，耐心等待解决。特此通知铁业工人服从党部指示，即日起复工。

（加盖工会印章）。

5月19日同盛棉纺厂宿舍驱逐租户事件的后续

关于5月19日在澳门路同盛棉纺厂宿舍驱逐租户期间，一名被控袭击日本籍人士的华籍男子一案（参见1936年5月20日情报报告），原告于5月27日在上海特区法院撤诉。

Iron Foundries - strike of workers

About noon May 26 the workers of the majority of iron
foundries in Shanghai declared a strike ostensibly to
support a demand for the release of one of their colleagues
named Nyien Loh Nyi ( 倪祿年 ), an employee of the
Zung Kyi Iron Works, 55 Chusan Road, who was arrested
by the Settlement Police at 10.30 a.m. the same day on charges
of assault and malicious damage. It is learned that the
actual reason for the strike is a demand of the workers
for a reduction in working hours.

At 1.20 p.m. May 26, about 500 workers from foundries
in the Northern District visited factories in the Eastern
District in an effort to persuade all iron workers to join
the strike. Upon arrival at the Nyi Shing Tsung Iron
Works, 444/21 Wayside Road, the workers were dispersed
by Police from Yulin Road Station.

劳工

怡和缫丝厂——恢复运营

位于成都路1037号的怡和（Ewo）缫丝厂于5月18日暂停运营（参见1936年5月19日情报报告），于5月27日恢复运营。该企业雇用约1000名工人。

铁厂——工人罢工

5月26日中午左右，上海大多数铁厂的工人宣布罢工，表面上是为了支持释放其同事倪祿年（Nyien Loh Nyi）。倪是中山路55号众记铁厂（Zung Kyi Iron Works）的员工，于当天上午10时30分因袭击和恶意破坏罪被租界警察逮捕。据悉，罢工的实际原因是工人要求缩短工时。

5月26日下午1时20分，来自北区各铁厂的约500名工人前往东区各工厂，试图说服所有铁工加入罢工。当他们到达韦赛德路444/21号的义盛总铁厂（Nyi Shing Tsung Iron Works）时，被榆林路巡捕房的警察驱散。

May 27, 1936.

-3-

On the morning of May 27, copies of a notice chopped
by the Iron Foundry Workers' Union were posted at the
entrances of iron foundries in Shanghai. A full translation
of this notice reads as follows :-

"Notification of the Shanghai Municipality Iron
Foundry Workers' Union

"Urgent notice is hereby issued that at 10 a.m. May 26,
"Nyien Lch-nyi ( 倪 礼 年 ), a worker of the Zung Kee
"( 慎 記 ) Iron Foundry, 551 Chusan Road, was arrested
"by the Police at the instance of the management. This
"act has aroused the indignation of the public and resulted
"in a strike. These facts have been reported to this Union by
"a number of workers. This Union has requested the local
"Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social Affairs to detail
"officials to investigate the matter and carry out necessary
"negotiations. All workers are hereby instructed to observe
"order, wait patiently for a settlement and to guard against
"the activities of reactionary elements.

May 27, 1936."

There are 197 iron foundries in Shanghai, employing a
complement of 2,000 hands. The majority of these concerns
are affected.

The strike situation this morning, May 27, remains
unchanged.

Miscellaneous

Rent Reduction Movement

Ten committee members of the Federation of Rent Reduction
Movement Committees of Various Districts of Shanghai held a
meeting in their office at 174 Shanhaikwan Road at 4 p.m. May
26 and passed the following resolutions :-

1) That the Chinese Ratepayers' Association of the International
Settlement be requested to urge the S.M.C. to re-assess
the value of land.

2) That the Executive Yuan be requested to order the formation
of rent arbitration committees.

3) That Chen Ki-pou ( 鄭劍波 ) and Sung Sing-fu ( 沈心福 )
be appointed to submit a petition to the Government

following. The workers in question, 12 in number have for some

them to cease work at 5.30 p.m. instead of the present 6 p.m.
The matter has already been discussed by the management, the
Iron Workers Union and the Bureau of Social Affairs, but no
decision arrived at.
To-day the workers demanded an assurance from the owner
one Van Koh Oen (范國安) that they be allowed to cease oper-

attitude he would close the foundry until negotiations regard-
ing working hours were completed.
After the workers had received from the owner $1.00 each

orderly manner.

from this Station.
